dedupe_keys.name: a robust active power control algorithm to maximize wind farm power tracking margins in waked conditions

description: Tamaro, Simone and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The evaluated algorithm combines induction control with yaw steering to increase available power and adds a proportional-integral loop to correct offline setpoints. Steady and unsteady comparisons use two layouts and large-eddy actuator-line simulations against three reference controllers. A companion deposit explicitly supplies C++ code for the four algorithms alongside data, establishing implementation access. Reduced saturation and fatigue are reported within those simulations; no physical controller deployment or universal performance gain is claimed. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
